Changes.note: “Submit” sends a password link, valid once and for 30 minutes, to the account of the user name or e-mail you typed. “Save password” replaces your old password; the old one no longer works, and only another reset changes it again. With “Sign out on my other devices” ticked, your account's sessions on other devices end too.
